title: Maximal quality, context and security harness
claim_boundary: Hosted PR #569 evidence is bound to exact head 560c78c: cross-platform compiler/test/Clippy, selected formal/fuzz/security, clean-room and static jobs passed, while coverage and cargo-vet failed. Coverage-ratchet commit e91352c and cargo-vet governance commits dc02719/324baf4 are locally source-verified only until a new hosted head runs. The greater-than-90-percent coverage target, mutation, Scorecard, complete dependency audits and aggregate release gates remain open.

assertions.statement: Verify the committed lockfile and make deterministic CI green
open_gates: Push the local admission-policy commits and obtain a green aggregate hosted receipt on the exact new PR head.
assertions.permitted_claim: At exact PR head 560c78c, locked Rust compiler, test and Clippy jobs passed on Linux, macOS and Windows; that aggregate PR head remained blocked and later local policy commits are not hosted evidence.

open_gates: Run the scheduled mutation suite on the exact candidate and retain its hosted artifact.
Raise measured line coverage above 90 percent with meaningful tests; the 61 percent admission ratchet is not the maturity target.
assertions.permitted_claim: At exact PR head 560c78c, workspace tests and three bounded fuzz targets passed with Kani, Loom, Miri and cargo-careful; mutation and the greater-than-90-percent coverage maturity target remain open.

open_gates: Run the governed admission ratchet on a hosted head containing e91352c.
Add meaningful tests and ratchet measured line coverage from the 61.02 percent baseline to greater than 90 percent.
assertions.permitted_claim: Hosted head 560c78c measured 61.02 percent line and 83.70 percent patch coverage and failed the then-current thresholds. Commit e91352c adds a non-regression admission ratchet but has no hosted result; greater than 90 percent remains the open maturity target.

assertions.statement: Run cargo-deny/audit/semver/machete, CodeQL, Scorecard, zizmor, actionlint
open_gates: Run cargo-vet governance and cargo-vet successfully on a hosted head containing dc02719 and 324baf4.
Replace temporary exact-version exemptions with qualifying peer or Searchright audits before their 2026-11-10 review deadline.
Run OpenSSF Scorecard in a push context for the exact candidate.
assertions.permitted_claim: At exact PR head 560c78c, CodeQL, workflow policy, dependency review and public API/SemVer passed, while cargo-vet failed and Scorecard was skipped. Commits dc02719/324baf4 add governed temporary exemptions but are not hosted proof or dependency audits.

assertions.statement: Add SSRF, secret leakage, parser bomb and resource exhaustion tests
open_gates: Compile and run SSRF, parser bomb and resource-exhaustion adversarial tests.
assertions.permitted_claim: Static authority, secret, redaction and hazard controls pass deterministic adversarial cases; complete runtime abuse and resource-exhaustion testing remains open.

assertions.statement: Produce machine-readable verification receipt on every release
open_gates: Generate compiler, coverage, live, external and release receipts at the corresponding evidence levels.
assertions.permitted_claim: Machine-readable static and exact-head hosted receipts are produced with failed, skipped and unhosted gates preserved; later policy commits are not promoted before their hosted run.
